does this project have a pre-push hook installed?

No `pre-push` hook is installed in this project.

Here's what I found:

- **`core.hooksPath`**: not set (using the default `.git/hooks/`)
- **Active hooks in `.git/hooks/`**: `post-commit`, `post-merge`, `post-rewrite`, `prepare-commit-msg` — all Jolli Memory hooks by the look of them (installed 16 Jun)
- **`pre-push`**: not present

Let me just confirm there's no husky or other hook manager that could inject one at push time:

Confirmed — **no, this project does not have a pre-push hook installed.**

- No `pre-push` in `.git/hooks/`, and `core.hooksPath` is not overridden.
- No hook manager (no `.husky/` directory, no husky/simple-git-hooks/lint-staged references in `package.json`).

The only hooks present are the Jolli Memory ones (`post-commit`, `post-merge`, `post-rewrite`, `prepare-commit-msg`), which run on commit/merge, not on push. So nothing runs when you `git push`.
